verdict: No concrete correctness blocker found for the stated tiny FP64 causal depthwise convolution, SiLU, and minimal raw-history adjoint contract.

validation.oracle: Independent scalar time-index equation with math.fsum, direct raw-history indexing and central directional differences; no subject forward/helper reused in scalar oracle. Separate full-K serving-state indexing check and analytical returned-history-only loss.
validation.covered: K1/K4/K8, 1/3/9/32-token chunks, with/without bias, positive and negative array strides, shorter-than-history chunks, no input mutation, saturated SiLU, late-output and final-history cotangents, repeated one-token backward state handoff.
validation.probe_ruff: passed after formatting; implementation was not edited

source_contract_checked.contract: Packed q|k|v channels [B,C,T], weight[C,K], depthwise cross-correlation with K-1 left zeros for sequence start, optional per-channel bias and SiLU. The mathematical FP64 reference preserves the ordering of kernel taps.

Inference Torch reference concatenates the first K state columns with current input, computes valid convolution and keeps the final T outputs. Dropping the oldest of those K input-state columns maps exactly to this oracle minimal K-1 history; current code does not implement larger history/speculative serving-state layouts.
Returned state is the final K-1 raw inputs, including previous history when T<K-1, rather than activated convolution outputs.
SiLU derivative and direct depthwise weight/input adjoints include both output cotangent and returned-history cotangent; K1 returns empty history.
Strict finite FP64 arrays and bounded B<=2,C<=64,T<=32,K<=8; shape errors, nonfinite inputs and detected forward/adjoint overflow reject.

next_milestone: The reference can be used as a small independent convolution/history component oracle for subsequent GDN composition. That composition and any backend implementation still need their own tests.
qualification_scope: Continuous FP64 CPU mathematical reference only; no implementation or active DeepSeek runtime edits by this reviewer.
No PyTorch/MLX/Metal execution, real checkpoint payload, compiled-kernel parity, serving state ABI, dtype-cast/rounding parity or complete Qwen layer/model qualification.
Target config uses K4 and 10240 packed q/k/v channels (2*16*128+48*128), whereas implementation allows at most64 channels/32 tokens. No target-dimension, 16K training, memory or throughput claim.
No document boundary resets, packed-sequence masks, projections, recurrence/output norm composition or optimizer updates are implemented by this component.
Input finite and overflow validation is exercised by author tests and inspected; the sampled numerical checks do not certify all representable FP64 inputs.
